title: Should be free…
body: This game has so many bugs and issues, my main problem is the building mode. It suddenly stops working and won’t allow you to scale/ rotate, zoom in or out, and sometimes completely resets your build. I have had so much frustration building items and it not being saved, or making rims and having keep reset the game. For $3 and even more money you spend on currency, this game has too many bugs. It’s fun but in order to build nice things you either; have to spend lots of hours and money building these items for them to come out mediocre do to the games lack of builder friendly ui/tools, OR, join the gatekeeped clubs. CONCLUSION. The builder mode has be improved in so many ways, more objects, morphing modes, being able to implement codes or something alike for custom shapes, and fix the bugs. Also the gold should be at least easier to earn, or cheaper in the store. This game can be fun but it’s such a simple sandbox mode type game that should be better for $3. The game is a blast but has a potential to be better
